name: Lemon Yogurt Chicken
description: Chicken marinated in Greek yogurt and lemon, then cooked until tender.

instructions.text: Set out a mixing bowl, measuring spoons, a baking dish, tongs, and an instant-read food thermometer. Use 1 1/2 pounds boneless, skinless chicken breasts. Do not rinse raw chicken. Wash hands and utensils after touching it.

Peel and finely chop 2 garlic cloves. Wash 1 lemon, cut it in half, and squeeze its juice into the bowl, removing seeds. Add 3/4 cup plain Greek yogurt and 1 tablespoon olive oil. Stir in the garlic until the mixture is evenly combined.
Add the chicken and turn it with tongs until coated on all sides. Cover the bowl and refrigerate for 30 minutes. Keep it refrigerated during marinating; do not leave raw chicken on the counter.

Near the end of marinating, preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C) with a rack in the center. Arrange the chicken in a single layer in the baking dish with a small space between pieces. Discard marinade left in the mixing bowl and wash the bowl and tongs.

Bake for 18–25 minutes, then insert a clean thermometer sideways into the thickest center of each breast. Every piece must reach 165°F (74°C). Thick pieces may take longer; continue baking and check every 3–5 minutes until all are ready.

Remove the dish with oven mitts and let the chicken rest for 5 minutes. Use a clean knife and board to slice it across the grain into strips. Divide into 4 portions and spoon cooked juices from the baking dish over the chicken before serving.

source.originalInstructions: Marinate chicken with Greek yogurt, lemon, garlic, olive oil, and black pepper. Cook until the chicken reaches 165 F.
